narrative_purpose: Makes the latency problem visceral: a single faint electrochemical pulse creeping along a glowing neural cable that stretches across a whole curved moonscape, a signal that would take days to cross the network end to end — the quiet demolition of the 'planet thinking in real time' romance.
subject: A vast curved horizon of a Pandoran moon seen from high altitude at night, the land laced with a faint glowing neural-root network like veins of light; along one strand a single small bright pulse of light creeps forward, with a long dark stretch of un-traversed cable ahead of it, dwarfed by the sheer distance it must cover.
scene: A planetary-scale night view: the curve of the moon, a web of dim bioluminescent neural cabling spanning continents, one tiny travelling pulse making its slow way along a single thread.
camera: A high, wide, slightly orbital vantage so the curvature of the moon and the vastness of the network are felt, the lone pulse small within it.
light: The neural web a dim, cool cyan tracery across dark land; the single travelling pulse a brighter point of teal-white; faint planetshine from Polyphemus on the horizon.
palette: Void-indigo and near-black land, dim cyan neural web, one brighter teal pulse, faint magenta-blue planetshine glow at the limb.
style: Painterly speculative-biology naturalist plate, hand-painted texture, atmospheric and vast.
detail_level: Fine and intricate on the glowing network tracery and the single pulse; the land softening into atmospheric haze toward the curved horizon.
composition: Curved horizon high in the frame, the web filling the dark land below, the lone pulse positioned with a long empty stretch of cable ahead to convey distance and slowness.
consistency_notes: Cool Pandora palette with from-within bioluminescent key on the network. The mood is vastness and slowness — the pulse must read as tiny against the distance. Keep dark sky for callout labels.
negative_prompt: no text, no lettering, no numbers, no logos, no diagram labels, no arrows, no photographic or 3D-render look, no lens flares, no neon UI glow, no cartoon or anime style
